The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2960f958368ee0ab), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a smooth Kähler–Ricci flow ht on M, for 0 ≤ t < ∞, with h0 = g. There are smooth real functions U, P and ρ such that 0 < ht ≤ g, ht = g − t Ric(g) + ∂ ¯ ∂U, U(⋅, 0) = 0, P = Ut = log det ht det g , ρ = −P ≥ 0, Rht = −Pt ≥ 0. (3.1) For each finite T, there is CT such that sup 0≤t≤T 1 Volg Bg(o, L) ∫ Bg(o,L) ρ(x, t) dVg(x) ≤ CT L (L ≥ 1). (3.2) At every fixed x, ρ(x, t) ≤ Cx(1 + t) for all t ≥ 0. Furthermore, on each finite time interval there is a smooth positive function Q and a constant c > 0 with Q ≥ c(1 + r2 ), (∂t − Δht )Q ≥ c trht g. (3.3) Smoothness at t = 0 means smoothness with all one-sided time derivatives.
